title: Tabs That Open and Close
description: A window-like tab bar of notes: each Tab has onRemove, which shows a close mark and closes the tab with a press on the mark or with the Delete and Backspace keys, and the TabList has onReorder, which lets people drag a tab to a new place or move it with Ctrl+Shift and the arrow keys. The tab beside a closed tab takes its selection and its focus, the closed tab leaves with a width transition, and a TabRowButton after the TabList in a TabRow opens a tab, which grows in. A pointer can move a tab only with a drag, which does not meet WCAG 2.2 success criterion 2.5.7, so add another way to move a tab where you need that. Use it for documents or sessions that people open, close, and put in order, and use Buttons Beside the Tabs when the tabs stay the same.
